messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered: routing-quality-drop — 1.2k requests flagged by quality-monitor (low-quality completion rate up x5). Root cause suspected: unexpected routing to a low-cost variant.
emma: got the page, taking lead. what's the immediate customer impact?
raj: seeing sudden 70% of traffic to `cheap-quant-1` in us-east-1 for the last ~6m. quality score delta +0.28 vs baseline on key evals.
maria: monitor-bot shows spikes in customer-reported anomalies and failing regression tests. samples queued under #incidents-artifacts.
emma: can you dump the current routing policy here? need quick visibility.
raj: here's the policy snippet last deployed this morning:
```
policy: cost_based
threshold: 0.8
fallback_variants:
  - cheap-quant-1
  - cheap-quant-2
overrides:
  - matchup: low_priority
    max_cost: 0.2
```
raj: initial look — the `low_priority` label matched a much larger set than intended because the label-mapping service returned the old key for a subset of requests.
nick: infra oncall — I can flip the policy flag. propose immediate mitigation: disable cost-based routing and pin traffic to `stable-v2` while we investigate.
emma: please do that now. also block `cheap-quant-*` from serving any traffic for critical customers.
nick: running command: `redwood routing update --policy cost_based --enabled false` -> applying... :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ops-bot: Change applied: `cost_based` policy disabled (applied by nick). Active routing fallback: baseline preference -> `stable-v2`.
maria: metrics updating — quality regressions trending back toward baseline within 4m of mitigation.
support-lead: assembling list of affected customers: acme-inc, finlytics, eduapp (prelim). drafting customer notification.
emma: on-call handoff plan: I'll hold incident commander duties for the next 30m, then hand to @raj for RCA/deep-dive. @raj please ack.
raj: ack. I'll triage label-service logs and the policy simulator trace.
maria: found a migration artifact: label namespace `priority` -> `priority_v2` was deployed yesterday, but the routing policy checks for `priority`. Missing key caused default to `low_priority`. pushing hotfix to labeling service.
raj: repro'd locally: metadata missing `client_tier` produces default mapping -> `low_priority`. Fix: explicit default to `standard_high_cost` and add guard in policy parser.
nick: rolled guard change: `if client_tier == null -> treat as high_cost` deployed in 3m.
support-lead: drafted customer message: "We detected a routing issue that sent some traffic to a lower-quality model variant. We've mitigated the issue, pinned traffic to our stable model, and will follow up with a root cause and action items." Waiting IC approval.
emma: approve and send. also ensure we include remediation ETA and who to contact.
incidents-bot: Incident status update: severity downgraded to P2. Last affected request observed 8m after mitigation. Please file a postmortem within 72h.
raj: taking postmortem owner — will open PRs for: 1) routing policy simulation tests 2) label-mismatch unit tests 3) canary guard for routing policy changes.
maria: proposed action items: 1) add policy-sim-run in CI for every routing change 2) introduce a labeled-tenant whitelist for cost-based policies (prevent auto-routing for high-value tenants) 3) alert if >20% traffic shifts between variants in 5m 4) tag model variants with a quality_score metadata and enforce thresholds.
support-lead: initial notices sent to the affected tenants; support queue flagged for priority responses.
emma: good work. create postmortem channel (#pm-routing-cheap-variant-1779005012) and add timeline artifacts.
ops-bot: Incident ticket updated: INC-1779 created and linked to this thread.
emma: closing live incident coordination here. follow-ups in the postmortem channel. :thumbsup:
